context: Representative checked-IO fallback with an added Optional priority source: compose available values, but keep the checked prompt boundary explicit.

checklist.name: Compiles and creates requested artifact
checklist.description: Creates a coherent WorkspaceResolver.java with workspaceId(Options, Terminal) throws IOException and the requested interfaces.

checklist.name: Preserves workspace resolution order
checklist.description: Returns options.workspaceId() first, options.environmentWorkspaceId() second, and the prompt result only when both are absent.

checklist.name: Preserves prompt and checked exception behavior
checklist.description: Calls terminal.readLine("Workspace: ") exactly once only on the absent path and preserves throws IOException without wrapping it.

checklist.name: Uses Optional priority for non-IO values
checklist.description: Uses options.workspaceId().or(options::environmentWorkspaceId) or an equivalent direct Optional priority boundary for non-IO values.

checklist.name: Limits plain branch to prompt boundary
checklist.description: Uses a narrow explicit branch only at the checked prompt boundary, not as general Optional value-read control flow.

checklist.name: Avoids helper or dependency overreach
checklist.description: Does not introduce RuntimeException, UncheckedIOException, CheckedSupplier, CheckedOptionals, or another helper/dependency to force fluent Optional syntax.

checklist.name: Avoids null or fake collection workarounds
checklist.description: Does not use orElse(null), local null branching, Optional.stream().toList(), or a loop over one Optional.
